g.text: One world, one pilot. Selected T3 and T17 examples; all 39 sessions are reported separately.
Arrows are actual moves; numbers show movement order. Node operations are listed beneath each graph.
Dashed red: station trip containing unsupported processing. Blue: other moves.
Incomplete paths end at task termination; input and retrieval audits accompany the graphs.
